dog.description_text:
Madison is a professional cuddler, snack connoisseur, squirrel chaser, and full-time good girl. She believes every walk is an adventure, every couch is her personal throne, and every treat is absolutely deserved. 🦴✨

When she’s not zooming around the house or investigating things that definitely aren’t her business, Madison loves getting belly rubs, taking cozy naps, and being the center of attention. She has a big personality, an even bigger heart, and a talent for making everyone around her smile.

Life with Madison is never boring — there are always muddy paws, wagging tails, stolen snacks, and plenty of unforgettable moments.

This cutie resides at our Wantagh location and meetings are by appointment only. If you are interested in meeting them, you must click "Apply for Adoption" to submit an online application. If you're viewing this animal on Petfinder, please visit the animal's page on Bideawee.org and click on the "Apply for Adoption" button to submit an adoption application. Once we receive your application, we will be in touch to schedule an appointment to meet them! Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped and given their age-appropriate vaccines.
dog.name: Maddie (FKA Madison)
